positions.title: Director of Polling Initiative
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: I lead the Polling Initiative of the Columbia Political Union, Columbia University’s Multipartisan political organization; duties include research about sampling & surveying methods, statistical inference, public opinion polling, and data analysis, with the goal of establishing the first official student polling organization of Columbia University. During the summer I helped run the Ambassadors program which includes engaging incoming first-year students in the club and mentoring them. I developed an onboarding process for our students with no coding experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Pandas (Software) · NumPy · Data Science · Python (Programming Language) · SciPy · Matplotlib

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Principal Investigator: Julia Hirschberg

Worked in a natural language processing (NLP) research lab for the summer on two projects: (1) identifying acoustic-prosodic and lexical features of empathetic vs. neutral human speech in order to develop a model to detect and generate empathy (2) using Praat, align the Switchboard Dialogue Acts corpus and make it publicly & freely available to advance NLP research. 

My funding for this project came from Barnard College through the Summer Research Institute.
positions.insights: Skills: Pandas (Software) · Praat · Machine Learning · Data Science · Python (Programming Language) · SciPy · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Data Analysis Intern
positions.description: Worked on a team of software engineers full time. Responsibilities included data analysis of Bitcoin price data in Python, implementing & testing several simple crypto automated trading algorithms, and creating a final presentation on a comparison of their performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Pandas (Software) · NumPy · Bitcoin · Data Science · Python (Programming Language)

honors.title: DivHacks Winning Team
honors.description: DivHacks is Columbia's annual diversity hackathon. Using HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Wix, my team created a website focused on disaster relief in Puerto Rico, where people can share information and request or provide assistance. We won for best beginner project and best project using Wix.

honors.title: Hispanic Scholarship Fund Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Hispanic Scholarship Fund · Jun 2022

volunteerExperiences.description: ASLAN Youth Ministries is a nonprofit dedicated to serving underprivileged communities with a focus on supporting children. I was a camp counselor for two summers, a total of four weeks for 25 hours per week. I tutored a 3rd-grade student in math and English during the 2018-2019 academic year.

volunteerExperiences.role: Fundraising and Public Advocacy Team Member
volunteerExperiences.description: The Remedy Project is dedicated to helping protect the rights of incarcerated people through the administrative remedy process. I am working on process automation to help them process their large number of clients (automatically generate mailing labels and files, etc.). I also help with fundraising by networking and posting on social media.
